mapper.select: SELECT tm.task_id AS taskId, tm.project_member_id AS projectMemberId, wm.member_id AS memberId, NVL(md.name, '멤버#' || tm.project_member_id) AS memberName, pm.role AS role, md.profile AS profile, TO_CHAR(tm.created, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS created FROM task_members tm JOIN project_members pm ON tm.project_member_id = pm.project_member_id LEFT JOIN workspace_members wm ON pm.workspace_member_id = wm.workspace_member_id LEFT JOIN member_details md ON wm.member_id = md.member_id WHERE tm.task_id = #{taskId} AND pm.status = 0 ORDER BY pm.role DESC, tm.project_member_id ASC

SELECT stm.sub_task_id AS subTaskId, stm.task_id AS taskId, stm.project_member_id AS projectMemberId, wm.member_id AS memberId, NVL(md.name, '멤버#' || stm.project_member_id) AS memberName, pm.role AS role, md.profile AS profile, TO_CHAR(stm.created, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS created FROM sub_task_members stm JOIN project_members pm ON stm.project_member_id = pm.project_member_id LEFT JOIN workspace_members wm ON pm.workspace_member_id = wm.workspace_member_id LEFT JOIN member_details md ON wm.member_id = md.member_id WHERE stm.sub_task_id = #{subTaskId} AND pm.status = 0 ORDER BY pm.role DESC, stm.project_member_id ASC

SELECT pm.project_member_id AS projectMemberId, wm.member_id AS memberId, NVL(md.name, '멤버#' || pm.project_member_id) AS memberName, pm.role AS role, md.profile AS profile FROM project_members pm LEFT JOIN workspace_members wm ON pm.workspace_member_id = wm.workspace_member_id LEFT JOIN member_details md ON wm.member_id = md.member_id WHERE pm.project_id = #{projectId} AND pm.status = 0 ORDER BY pm.role DESC, pm.project_member_id ASC
mapper.insert: MERGE INTO task_members tm USING dual ON (tm.task_id = #{taskId} AND tm.project_member_id = #{projectMemberId}) WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (task_id, project_member_id, created) VALUES (#{taskId}, #{projectMemberId}, SYSDATE)

MERGE INTO sub_task_members stm USING dual ON (stm.sub_task_id = #{subTaskId} AND stm.project_member_id = #{projectMemberId}) WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (sub_task_id, task_id, project_member_id, created) VALUES (#{subTaskId}, #{taskId}, #{projectMemberId}, SYSDATE)
mapper.select: SELECT dr.daily_report_id AS dailyReportId, dr.sub_task_id AS subTaskId, dr.project_member_id AS projectMemberId, NVL(md.name, '담당자#' || dr.project_member_id) AS writerName, TO_CHAR(dr.report_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS reportDate, dr.content, dr.progress, dr.status, TO_CHAR(dr.created, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS created, TO_CHAR(dr.updated, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS updated, rr.status AS reviewStatus, TO_CHAR(rr.viewed, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS viewedAt, CASE WHEN dr.status = 0 AND rr.viewed IS NULL AND rr.reviewed IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS modifiable FROM daily_reports dr LEFT JOIN project_members pm ON dr.project_member_id = pm.project_member_id LEFT JOIN workspace_members wm ON pm.workspace_member_id = wm.workspace_member_id LEFT JOIN member_details md ON wm.member_id = md.member_id LEFT JOIN report_reviews rr ON dr.daily_report_id = rr.daily_report_id WHERE dr.sub_task_id = #{subTaskId} AND dr.deleted IS NULL ORDER BY dr.report_date DESC, dr.daily_report_id DESC

SELECT dr.daily_report_id AS dailyReportId, dr.sub_task_id AS subTaskId, dr.project_member_id AS projectMemberId, TO_CHAR(dr.report_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS reportDate, dr.content, dr.progress, dr.status, CASE WHEN dr.status = 0 AND rr.viewed IS NULL AND rr.reviewed IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS modifiable FROM daily_reports dr LEFT JOIN report_reviews rr ON dr.daily_report_id = rr.daily_report_id WHERE dr.daily_report_id = #{dailyReportId} AND dr.deleted IS NULL
mapper.insert:
SELECT seq_daily_reports.NEXTVAL FROM dual
INSERT INTO daily_reports ( daily_report_id, sub_task_id, project_member_id, report_date, content, progress, status, created, updated ) VALUES ( #{dailyReportId}, #{subTaskId}, #{projectMemberId}, NVL(TO_DATE(#{reportDate, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'YYYY-MM-DD'), SYSDATE), #{content, jdbcType=CLOB}, NVL(#{progress}, 0), 0, SYSDATE, SYSDATE )
mapper.update: UPDATE daily_reports dr SET dr.report_date = NVL(TO_DATE(#{reportDate, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'YYYY-MM-DD'), dr.report_date), dr.content = #{content, jdbcType=CLOB}, dr.progress = NVL(#{progress}, dr.progress), dr.updated = SYSDATE WHERE dr.daily_report_id = #{dailyReportId} AND dr.status = 0 AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM report_reviews rr WHERE rr.daily_report_id = dr.daily_report_id AND (rr.viewed IS NOT NULL OR rr.reviewed IS NOT NULL) )

UPDATE daily_reports dr SET dr.deleted = SYSDATE, dr.updated = SYSDATE WHERE dr.daily_report_id = #{dailyReportId} AND dr.status = 0 AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM report_reviews rr WHERE rr.daily_report_id = dr.daily_report_id AND (rr.viewed IS NOT NULL OR rr.reviewed IS NOT NULL) )
